newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Malawi's economy to grow 7 pct in 1997 - minister.
newsitem.headline: Malawi's economy to grow 7 pct in 1997 - minister.

text.p: Malawi's economy will grow by at least seven percent in 1997, the country's finance minister, Aleke Banda, said on Wednesday.
Banda made the forecast at a seminar on the sidelines of the annual meeting of the African Development Bank.
He said the country "was in tatters" when the democratic government took over in May 1994, with inflation at 100 percent, interest rates at 70 percent and negative growth.
Within less than two years inflation had been slashed to seven percent, and economic growth rates of 9.5 percent and nine percent were recorded in 1995 and 1996 respectively.
"During the course of this year, we expect a growth rate of at least seven percent," Banda said.
